name: agent_model_metadata_extract_pricing
notes: Pricing extraction (provider_metadata.c vs LIVE agent/model_metadata.py). Documented divergences / exclusions: (1) C formats numeric prices with %.12g while LIVE uses str(float) — integer-valued results differ textually ('5' vs '5.0'); the cup therefore hashes result KEY names, not values. (2) C lacks the LIVE DeepInfra metadata.pricing branch — deepinfra payloads excluded. (3) C walks only two nesting levels vs LIVE's full recursion — payloads kept to one level. (4) String-valued novita keys diverge (LIVE float()-coerces, C ignores).
